title: Jordan Size
verification: The integrated declaration JordanSize.lemma_1_1 and scalar-extension bridge passed the Lean kernel. Jordan sizes are stated through generalized-eigenspace annihilation and the full kernel-growth profile; no explicit Jordan basis is constructed.

main.formalType:
JordanSize.lemma_1_1.{u, u_1} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K] [IsAlgClosed K] (n : ℕ) {M : Fin n → Type u}
  {Z : Type u} [(i : Fin n) → AddCommGroup (M i)] [(i : Fin n) → Module K (M i)] [(i : Fin n) → Module ℚ (M i)]
  [∀ (i : Fin n), IsScalarTower ℚ K (M i)] [∀ (i : Fin n), FiniteDimensional K (M i)] [∀ (i : Fin n), Nontrivial (M i)]
  [AddCommGroup Z] [Module K Z] [Module ℚ Z] [IsScalarTower ℚ K Z] [FiniteDimensional K Z] [Nontrivial Z]
  (B : MultilinearMap K M Z) (T : (i : Fin n) → Module.End K (M i)) (R : Module.End K Z)
  (hT : ∀ (i : Fin n), IsUnit (T i)) (hR : IsUnit R)
  (hB : ∀ (x : (i : Fin n) → M i), R (B x) = B fun i => (T i) (x i)) :
  (∀ (i : Fin n), JordanSize.LogarithmicChainStatement (JordanSize.jordanFactors (T i) ⋯)) ∧
    JordanSize.LogarithmicChainStatement (JordanSize.jordanFactors R hR) ∧
      (∀ (x : (i : Fin n) → M i),
          (JordanSize.jordanFactors R hR).u (B x) = B fun i => (JordanSize.jordanFactors (T i) ⋯).u (x i)) ∧
        ∀ (x : (i : Fin n) → M i),
          (JordanSize.jordanFactors R hR).log (B x) =
            ∑ i, B (Function.update x i ((JordanSize.jordanFactors (T i) ⋯).log (x i)))

title: 对数的核与像
Kernels and images
setup: 域上向量空间、幂零算子 D。
A vector space over a field and a nilpotent D.
result: 乘交换可逆因子，所有幂的核与像不变。
A commuting unit preserves every kernel and image.
scope: 多项式过滤等式；实际对数的识别由有限求值完成。
Polynomial filtration identity; finite evaluation identifies the actual logarithm.
nodes.formalType:
JordanSize.logarithmicChains.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
  (D : Module.End K V) (hD : IsNilpotent D) (m : ℕ) :
  IsNilpotent (JordanSize.logFinite D m) ∧
    (∀ (j : ℕ),
        LinearMap.ker (JordanSize.logFinite D m ^ j) = LinearMap.ker (D ^ j) ∧
          LinearMap.range (JordanSize.logFinite D m ^ j) = LinearMap.range (D ^ j) ∧
            (JordanSize.logFinite D m ^ j = 0 ↔ D ^ j = 0)) ∧
      nilpotencyClass (JordanSize.logFinite D m) = nilpotencyClass D

title: 广义特征分量的乘积
Generalized products
setup: 三个向量空间及等变双线性映射。
Three vector spaces and an equivariant bilinear map.
result: 移位幂 p、q 给出乘积的移位幂 p+q−1。
Shifted powers p,q give the product bound p+q−1.
scope: 分量结论经谱分解与双线性推广到任意向量。
The componentwise statement is extended by spectral decomposition and bilinearity.

title: 有限指数流
Finite exponential flow
setup: 有理空间上的幂零算子 D。
A nilpotent D on a rational space.
result: 参数相加对应相乘，负参数给出逆元。
Parameter addition gives multiplication; negative parameters give inverses.
scope: 复用 mathlib 的有限指数。
Uses mathlib’s finite exponential.
nodes.formalType:
JordanSize.nilpotentFlow.{u_1} {V : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℚ V] (D : Module.End ℚ V) (hD : IsNilpotent D) :
  JordanSize.flow D 0 = 1 ∧
    (∀ (s t : ℚ), JordanSize.flow D (s + t) = JordanSize.flow D s * JordanSize.flow D t) ∧
      (∀ (t : ℚ), IsUnit (JordanSize.flow D t)) ∧
        (∀ (t : ℚ),
            JordanSize.flow D t * JordanSize.flow D (-t) = 1 ∧ JordanSize.flow D (-t) * JordanSize.flow D t = 1) ∧
          ∀ (m : ℕ), JordanSize.flow D ↑m = JordanSize.flow D 1 ^ m

title: 乘法 Jordan 分解
Multiplicative decomposition
setup: 完美域上的有限维空间、可逆 T。
A finite-dimensional space over a perfect field and an invertible T.
result: T=SU，S 半单、U 幺幂且两者交换。
T=SU with commuting semisimple S and unipotent U.
scope: 不需要配对或正性。
No pairing or positivity is needed.
nodes.formalType:
JordanSize.multiplicativeDecomposition.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [Field K] [PerfectField K]
  [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] (T : Module.End K V) (hT : IsUnit T) :
  ∃ S U, S ∈ K[T] ∧ S.IsSemisimple ∧ IsUnit S ∧ IsNilpotent (U - 1) ∧ IsUnit U ∧ Commute S U ∧ T = S * U

title: 形式对数与指数
Formal logarithm and exponential
setup: 有理系数形式幂级数。
Formal power series over the rationals.
result: 形式对数与指数互逆。
Formal logarithm and exponential are inverse.
scope: 求值连接在后续两张卡片中验证。
The evaluation bridge is checked in the following two cards.
nodes.formalType:

  PowerSeries.subst (PowerSeries.log ℚ) (PowerSeries.exp ℚ) = 1 + PowerSeries.X ∧
    PowerSeries.subst (PowerSeries.exp ℚ - 1) (PowerSeries.log ℚ) = PowerSeries.X

title: 幂级数的求值
Evaluation of series
setup: 满足声明所列拓扑条件的交换有理代数及幂零元。
A commutative rational algebra with the stated topological interfaces and a nilpotent element.
result: 互逆恒等式在该元上求值后仍成立。
The inverse identities remain true after evaluation.
scope: 拓扑只在内部离散子代数上使用；最终算子结论无拓扑假设。
Topology is internal to the discrete generated subalgebra; the operator theorem has no topological hypotheses.
nodes.formalType:
JordanSize.evaluatedInverse.{u_1} {A : Type u_1} [CommRing A] [Algebra ℚ A] [UniformSpace ℚ] [DiscreteUniformity ℚ]
  [UniformSpace A] [IsUniformAddGroup A] [T2Space A] [CompleteSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] [IsLinearTopology A A]
  (a : A) (ha : IsNilpotent a) (hmap : Continuous ⇑(algebraMap ℚ A)) :
  PowerSeries.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ A) (PowerSeries.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ A) a (PowerSeries.log ℚ)) (PowerSeries.exp ℚ) =

    PowerSeries.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ A) (PowerSeries.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ A) a (PowerSeries.exp ℚ) - 1)

      a

title: 有限求值连接
Finite evaluation bridge
setup: 交换有理代数、D^k=0，声明中的求值接口。
A commutative rational algebra, D^k=0 and the stated evaluation interfaces.
result: 有限对数的指数等于 1+D。
The exponential of the finite logarithm equals 1+D.
scope: 截断范围与幂零界明确对应。
The truncation is matched explicitly to the nilpotence bound.

title: 有限对数与指数互逆
Finite operator log and exp
setup: 任意有理代数中的幂零算子；不要求交换或拓扑。
Nilpotent elements in any rational algebra; no commutativity or topology assumed.
result: 有限 log 与 exp 互逆，exp 在幂零元上单射。
Finite log and exp are inverse; exp is injective on nilpotent elements.
scope: 使用由算子生成的交换子代数完成求值。
Evaluation takes place in the commutative subalgebra generated by the operator.

title: 幺幂部分的双线性相容性
Bilinear unipotent compatibility
setup: 代数闭域上的有限维空间、Jordan 分解及等变 B。
Finite-dimensional spaces over an algebraically closed field, Jordan factors and equivariant B.
result: U(B(x,y))=B(Ux,Uy)。
U(B(x,y))=B(Ux,Uy).
scope: 先对广义特征分量证明，再以双线性推广。
Proved on generalized eigencomponents, then extended by bilinearity.

title: 幺幂部分的多重线性相容性
Multilinear unipotent compatibility
setup: 代数闭域上的有限维空间、可逆算子及等变的任意有限元多重线性映射。
Finite-dimensional spaces over an algebraically closed field, invertible operators and any equivariant finite-arity multilinear map.
result: 幺幂部分保持每个给定映射。
The unipotent parts preserve each given map.
scope: 不假设乘法满足结合律。
No associativity of a multiplication is assumed.

title: 比较一次项
Comparison of linear coefficients
setup: 有理双线性映射及在整数参数上相容的有限指数。
A rational bilinear map and finite exponentials compatible at integer parameters.
result: 比较有限多项式的一次项得到 Leibniz 公式。
Linear coefficients give the Leibniz formula.
scope: 使用多项式恒等式，不使用求导。
Uses polynomial identities without differentiation.

title: 指数与链的过滤
Exponential chain filtrations
setup: 特征零系数域、幂零 D。
A characteristic-zero coefficient field and a nilpotent D.
result: exp(D)−I 与 D 的所有幂具有相同的核、像和零幂条件。
exp(D)−I and D have identical power kernels, images and vanishing conditions.
scope: 可逆因子 Q 的有限展开及可逆性均已证明。
The finite quotient Q and its invertibility are proved.
nodes.formalType:

  [Module K V] [Module ℚ V] [IsScalarTower ℚ K V] (D : Module.End K V) (hD : IsNilpotent D) (j : ℕ) :
  ((IsNilpotent.exp D - 1) ^ j).ker = LinearMap.ker (D ^ j) ∧
    ((IsNilpotent.exp D - 1) ^ j).range = LinearMap.range (D ^ j) ∧ ((IsNilpotent.exp D - 1) ^ j = 0 ↔ D ^ j = 0)

title: 对数的双线性 Leibniz 公式
Bilinear logarithmic Leibniz identity
setup: 代数闭特征零系数域、有限维空间、等变 B。
An algebraically closed characteristic-zero coefficient field, finite dimensions and equivariant B.
result: N(B(x,y))=B(Nx,y)+B(x,Ny)。
N(B(x,y))=B(Nx,y)+B(x,Ny).
scope: N 是实际的有限 log(U)，不是另行假设的导子。
N is the actual finite log(U), not an assumed derivation.

Multilinear Leibniz identity
setup: 代数闭特征零系数域、有限维空间、可逆算子及等变多重线性映射。
An algebraically closed characteristic-zero coefficient field, finite dimensions, invertible operators and an equivariant multilinear map.
result: 对数作用等于逐个变量作用后的求和。
The logarithmic action is the sum of its actions in individual slots.
scope: 包括零元映射；递归分离最后一个变量。
Includes arity zero; the proof recursively separates the last slot.

title: 正整数次幂
Positive integer powers
setup: 有限维特征零空间及乘法 Jordan 分解。
A finite-dimensional characteristic-zero space and multiplicative Jordan factors.
result: log(U^a)=a log(U)；非零缩放保持核与像。
log(U^a)=a log(U); nonzero scaling preserves kernels and images.
scope: Jordan 分解唯一性也单独验证。
Uniqueness of the Jordan factors is checked separately.

title: 全部整数指数
All integer exponents
setup: 有理代数、幂零 D、U=exp(D)，ℓ∈ℤ。
A rational algebra, nilpotent D, U=exp(D), and ℓ∈ℤ.
result: U^ℓ=exp(ℓD)，包括负整数。
U^ℓ=exp(ℓD), including negative integers.
scope: 负指数在可逆元群中定义。
Negative powers are defined in the unit group.

title: 广义特征空间的链长
Chain length in generalized eigenspaces
setup: 代数闭特征零域上的有限维空间、Jordan 分解。
A finite-dimensional space over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field and Jordan factors.
result: 所有广义特征空间的 j 次移位幂为零，当且仅当 N^j=0。
All generalized eigenspaces have zero shifted j-th powers iff N^j=0.
scope: 明确证明移位幂与幺幂部分的缩放公式。
Explicitly proves the scaling formula for shifted powers.

title: Jordan 块与核增长
Jordan blocks and kernel growth
setup: 非零有限维空间，代数闭特征零域。
A nonzero finite-dimensional space over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field.
result: 最大块由 N 的幂零指数刻画；取正整数次幂保留整个核增长。
The nilpotency class gives the largest block; positive powers preserve the full kernel-growth profile.
scope: 以广义特征空间的消去指数及核增长表述；不构造显式 Jordan 基。
Expressed through generalized-eigenspace annihilation and kernel growth; no explicit Jordan basis is constructed.
nodes.formalType:
JordanSize.largestJordanBlock_characterization.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K]
  [IsAlgClosed K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Module ℚ V] [IsScalarTower ℚ K V] [FiniteDimensional K V]
  {T : Module.End K V} [Nontrivial V] (F : JordanSize.Factors T) :
  JordanSize.largestJordanBlock T = 1 + (nilpotencyClass F.log - 1) ∧
    F.log ^ (JordanSize.largestJordanBlock T - 1) ≠ 0 ∧
      F.log ^ JordanSize.largestJordanBlock T = 0 ∧ ∀ (j : ℕ), JordanSize.largestJordanBlock T ≤ j → F.log ^ j = 0

Scalar extension

A field extension L/K with K perfect and finite dimensions; rational coefficients for the logarithm.
result: Jordan 分解及有限对数与标量扩张相容。
Jordan factors and the finite logarithm commute with scalar extension.
scope: 可用于有理空间扩张到实数或复数。
Applies to extending rational spaces to the reals or complexes.
